bootstrap_preservation.mode: named and reproducible v1 definition subset, not silently recounted into v2

cheap_gate.results_location: fresh generation_report.json from this generator's cheap gate

settings.holder_overlap: conservative whole-segment interval, summed mm^3, not chronological collision volume
settings.source_grid: exact task GridSpec, physical-mm source geometry
settings.stock_membership: hard stock SDF < 0 at voxel centres

count_parameterization: generate_tasks(dev_per_family, test_per_family, seed=...), and matching CLI flags

design_distance.metric: maximum abs(component_delta)/declared_scale over actual stock, pocket and physical retained-pad variants
design_distance.units: mm per scale entry; retained count uses a one-pad unit

disjoint_split_rule: within each family, every dev/test design differs physically and meets the global minimum-distance guard
predeclared_exclusion_reasons: unsupported or contradictory task/seed geometry
unreachable original target or finite-cutter/shank/holder access violation
failed task contract or nominal seed validation
incomplete reference coverage or unavailable/unsafe assembly clearance
residual over task tolerance or operation-target gouge over tolerance
cheap-worker timeout, memory bound or invalid execution evidence
scope: bounded analytic stock/pocket; open oblong or zero/one square retained pad; no free-form or multi-pad claim
suite_count_policy: declared generation defaults; freeze at T4.2, not an immutable v1 cap

accessibility.assembly_check: full-motion hard-sim radial cutter/holder geometry and holder interval screen; declared shank bottom/height and noncutting clearance; not just vertical visibility or a continuous collision proof
accessibility.operation_target_rule: flat upright finite cutter on full original walls; union original part with four corner boxes outside the radius cutter disks

cheap_gate.custom_target_scoring: actual hard-sim remaining/removed masks on exact declared 0.25 mm task grid
